name: Order of the Dragon
headerMeta: Golden era · Cavalry · ranged surge + RTS control · 310 leadership · Seasonal (T5)
pitch: A versatile heavy cavalry with strong flank engagement and skirmish presence, built on three ability modes: RTS view for damage boost, sweep for area threat, and self-heal for sustain. Weak in duels and poor against direct infantry engagement, so anchor it on the flank.

doctrines.name: Order of the Dragon Unique Doctrine
Other Movement Speed Doctrine
doctrines.note: replaces piercing/slashing pen for full movement-speed build

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Primary veterancy path per Amya; tested in skirmish / flank scenarios.

battleRole.positioning: Deploy on the flank where the high skirmish (7/10) and flank (8/10) ratings matter. Avoid prolonged 1v1 duels (3/10 rating) and direct front-line infantry engagement {1}.
battleRole.tips: Press 1 for RTS view control mode: enables damage boost and charge stance {1}. Press 2 for sweep ability: area threat like Khevtuul or Kriegsbruders {1}. Press 3 to heal: sustain tool for extended engagements {1}. Exploit +15% movement speed from Emperor's Expedition to reposition quickly {1}. On high-movement builds, swap Piercing/Slashing Pen for second movement-speed doctrine {1}.

controls.notes: Ability loop: (1) RTS view for damage + charge stance, (2) sweep for area control, (3) heal for sustain. {1}
